# StoveTop FireStop

> Automatic cooktop fire suppressors protecting residential kitchens from grease fires since 1972.

StoveTop FireStop manufactures innovative fire suppression systems for residential kitchens, including the LowPro magnetic system, Rangehood original suppressor, and Microhood dual-canister system. The company offers wholesale distribution, comprehensive safety documentation, and customer support programs including free replacement warranties.

## Key Topics

- Automatic fire suppression
- Cooktop fire safety
- Grease fire prevention
- LowPro system
- Rangehood suppressor
- Microhood system
- Kitchen fire protection
- Residential safety
- Fire suppression installation
- Stovetop safety
- Home fire safety
- Warranty programs
- Fire-safety certification
- Customer support
